payload.name: Search family additions including pets
payload.description: When a question asks who or what was added to or joined a named person's family/group within a time period, include pet-adoption and acquisition terms in retrieval, not only human family-member names.
content: When a question asks about a new addition to someone's family or group (e.g., 'new addition', 'joined the family', 'welcomed'), treat the addition as possibly a pet: run targeted hybrid/keyword searches combining the person's name with acquisition terms such as 'adopted', 'got', 'welcomed', 'new pet', 'brought home', and the time period if given.
Do not restrict family-member searches to human relations; if initial people-focused searches return no matching family member, search pet/animal adoption memories before answering.

If a matching adoption/acquisition memory is found, verify the entity's name and the event date from that memory; stop after one or two targeted addition searches return a consistent answer or after both people-focused and pet-focused searches exhaust.

solves: Questions asking who or what was added to a person's family within a time period often fail because retrieval is limited to human family-member names and misses pet adoptions stored as event memories.
